choose.when: and (vm.manufacturer ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or vm.model_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
choose.otherwise: and ( m.member_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.user_id ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cs.station_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or vm.model_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.charger_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '예약완료') as reservedCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '인증완료') as verifiedCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '충전중') as chargingCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '완료') as completedCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '취소') as canceledCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '노쇼') as noShowCount from reservation r join app_member m on r.member_id = m.member_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id

select count(*) filter (where r.status = '예약완료' and r.reservation_date = current_date) as waitingAuthCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '취소' and r.reservation_date = current_date) as cancelRequestCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '예약완료' and r.start_time < current_timestamp and r.reservation_date = current_date) as expectedNoShowCount , count(*) filter (where r.status = '인증완료' and r.start_time < current_timestamp and r.reservation_date = current_date) as delayedStartCount from reservation r

select count(*) from reservation r join app_member m on r.member_id = m.member_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id

select r.reservation_id as reservationId , concat('RSV-', lpad(r.reservation_id::text, 6, '0')) as reservationNo , r.start_time as startTime , r.end_time as endTime , m.member_name as memberName , m.user_id as userId , concat(vm.manufacturer, ' ', vm.model_name) as vehicleName , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as stationAddress , c.charger_name as chargerName , r.current_soc as currentSoc , r.target_soc as targetSoc , r.estimated_minutes as estimatedMinutes , round(r.estimated_cost) as estimatedCost , r.auth_code as authCode , r.status as status from reservation r join app_member m on r.member_id = m.member_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id
order by r.start_time desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select r.reservation_id as reservationId , concat('RSV-', lpad(r.reservation_id::text, 6, '0')) as reservationNo , m.member_id as memberId , m.member_name as memberName , m.phone as phone , m.email as email , concat(vm.manufacturer, ' ', vm.model_name) as vehicleName , v.plate_number as plateNumber , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as stationAddress , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , r.start_time as startTime , r.end_time as endTime , r.current_soc as currentSoc , r.target_soc as targetSoc , r.estimated_minutes as estimatedMinutes , round(r.estimated_cost) as estimatedCost , coalesce(r.auth_code, '-') as authCode , r.status as status , r.created_at as createdAt , r.updated_at as updatedAt from reservation r join app_member m on r.member_id = m.member_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.update: update reservation set status = '취소', canceled_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status in ('예약완료', '인증완료')
update reservation set status = '노쇼', no_show_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status in ('예약완료', '인증완료')
update reservation set status = '충전중', updated_at = current_timestamp where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and status = '인증완료'
